event_summary: A partially visible person on green turf changes posture while holding a red band that runs from a shoe area up to the hands.
raw_event_description: At the start, the view is close on a bent lower leg, a turquoise shoe, a red two-strand band, and one hand holding the band. The red band runs from the shoe area upward to the hand. The visible supporting leg becomes straighter, the band shifts from a diagonal angle to a more vertical line, and the camera reframes upward. Later, one leg is raised backward to the left while the torso leans forward. The hands hold the red band near the front of the body and then move lower as the arms become straighter. The camera continues to show a higher portion of the body, including hip, torso, arm, and part of the head.

reasons: Only the lower body, one forearm or hand, one shoe, the red band, and turf are visible.
The upper body and head are cropped out in the first frame.
The red band is already positioned near the shoe and held by the hand at the beginning.
